levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: «ح» separates two isnads for the same saying: two groups (rule 4)
the second isnad writes its own «حدثنا الأعمش، عن شقيق، عن» again, so no shared tail
«يعنون الملائكة» explains the Companions' words and names no transmitter
the Companion Ibn Masud is the last link; the Prophet is the end
